item.title: Xcode 27's MCP Can Inflate Token Costs When Driving the Simulator
item.description:
If you use an AI agent with Xcode 27's MCP server to navigate the iOS Simulator, your token bill may be higher than expected. SwiftLee's Antoine van der Lee benchmarked the setup and found that after every action, the Xcode MCP returns roughly seven times more text than RocketSim's CLI did, because the agent reads far more state after each tap.

The takeaway is that efficient agent navigation comes down to what the agent reads after every step, not just what it does. For developers leaning on AI-assisted testing and automation in the Simulator, that verbosity adds up fast, making it worth comparing MCP-based navigation against leaner tooling like RocketSim before committing to a workflow.
